overview.zh: Replay 按 CSV 时间轴输出 joint targets；运行状态、scope、跳帧/限幅和反馈通过 ReplayStatus 跟踪。Fault Recovery 分成查看故障、用户确认、RESET 与 Rope Init；这些操作不能互相替代。
overview.en: Replay sends joint targets on a CSV timeline; ReplayStatus tracks run state, scope, skipped/clamped frames, and feedback. Fault recovery separates fault review, user confirmation, RESET, and Rope Init; these operations are not interchangeable.

zh.plain: Replay 按轨迹时间发送关节目标；Send 在空闲时启动、运行时请求停止。
zh.condition: 入口由 Replay UI 状态或用户确认触发，详细控制顺序见该函数源码。
zh.effect: UI service 读取导入帧并通过 HandBackend/控制器发送；ReplayStatus 保留当前帧、目标、scope 和跳过/限幅信息。
zh.failure: 查看当前 frame、状态 message、warnings 和 joint masks，处理门禁后重试。
zh.recovery: Replay 是离线记录轨迹输入；ROS2 是实时外部输入。
zh.unknown: The UI service loads imported frames and sends through HandBackend/controller; ReplayStatus records frame, targets, scope, and skipped/clamped information.
zh.difference: Inspect frame, status message, warnings, and joint masks; clear the gate before retrying.
zh.change: Replay is recorded trajectory input; ROS2 is live external input.

en.plain: Replay sends joint targets along a trajectory timeline; Send starts while idle and requests stop while running.
en.condition: Entered from Replay UI state or user confirmation; see the function source for ordering.
en.effect: 通信断开、controller 未启动、状态不允许或帧无效可拒绝开始/中断播放。
en.failure: 源码能证明桌面调度，不能证明轨迹对实体手部安全或机械响应准确。
en.recovery: 基线未标记该流程为变更。
en.unknown: Disconnected communication, an unstarted controller, a disallowed state, or invalid frames can reject or interrupt playback.
en.difference: The source proves desktop scheduling, not that the trajectory is physically safe or mechanically accurate.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this workflow as changed.

zh.plain: Replay 面板的 _send_or_stop 根据 service.is_running() 在启动和停止间切换。
zh.condition: 源码判断：`self.service.is_running()`；`not ok`。表达式逐项决定此节点是否继续。
zh.effect: 空闲时校验输入并调用 replay start；运行时走停止/取消路径，并更新 UI 状态。
zh.failure: 查看 replay service 的 status/message 与 CSV 校验提示。
zh.recovery: 这是 UI service 协调，不是 P4 Replay 状态机。
zh.unknown: When idle it validates input and starts Replay; when running it takes the stop/cancel path and updates UI state.
zh.difference: Read Replay service status/message and CSV validation feedback.
zh.change: This coordinates the UI service, not the P4 state machine.

en.plain: _send_or_stop in the Replay panel switches between start and stop based on service.is_running().
en.condition: Source predicates: `self.service.is_running()`; `not ok`. Each expression determines whether this node continues.
en.effect: 输入校验或开始请求失败会显示拒绝原因；运行状态下的停止也可能等待异步收尾。
en.failure: 按钮名称 Send 不保证数据发送成功或播放完成。
en.recovery: 基线未标记该处理器为变更。
en.unknown: Input validation or start failure reports a reason; stopping may wait for asynchronous cleanup.
en.difference: The Send label does not guarantee target transmission or playback completion.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this handler as changed.

zh.plain: 若 Replay service 已在运行，重复点击 Send 的语义变为停止，而不是再启动第二条轨迹。
zh.condition: 源码判断：`self.service.is_running()`。表达式逐项决定此节点是否继续。
zh.effect: _send_or_stop 按 is_running 分支调用 service stop/cancel。
zh.failure: 条件为真时已有回放在运行，改走 stop/cancel；为假时准备启动新回放。
zh.recovery: 这是按钮的运行态切换条件。
zh.unknown: _send_or_stop branches to service stop/cancel when is_running is true.
zh.difference: Check whether ReplayStatus transitions from running to stopped/idle.
zh.change: This is the button’s running-state toggle.

en.plain: If Replay service is already running, another Send click means stop rather than starting a second trajectory.
en.condition: Source predicates: `self.service.is_running()`. Each expression determines whether this node continues.
en.effect: 运行状态下不会新建并发回放；停止收尾时间依服务实现。
en.failure: When true, a replay is already running, so take stop/cancel; when false, prepare a new replay.
en.recovery: 基线未标记该守卫为变更。
en.unknown: It avoids starting a concurrent replay; stop completion timing belongs to the service.
en.difference: A stop request is not proof of P4 target-stop feedback.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this guard as changed.

zh.plain: 开始结果 ok 为假时，UI 不应显示回放已成功启动。
zh.condition: 源码判断：`not ok`。表达式逐项决定此节点是否继续。
zh.effect: 成功时进入 running；失败时保留失败 message 并结束本次开始路径。
zh.failure: 条件为真时启动失败，不进入 running；为假时更新状态为已启动。
zh.recovery: 它检查启动结果，不检查某一帧的完成状态。
zh.unknown: On a false start result, the UI must not show Replay as successfully started.
zh.difference: Failure may come from file data, state admission, or the service; this boolean does not distinguish all causes.
zh.change: Successful start does not mean every frame was sent or playback completed.

en.plain: If the start result ok is false, the UI must not report Replay as started.
en.condition: Source predicates: `not ok`. Each expression determines whether this node continues.
en.effect: 失败通常由文件内容、状态准入或 service 拒绝返回；该布尔量不区分所有原因。
en.failure: When true, startup failed and does not enter running; when false, update status to running.
en.recovery: 基线未标记该守卫为变更。
en.unknown: Success enters running; failure retains the returned message and exits the start path.
en.difference: Read the returned message/warnings and fix the data or state blocker.
en.change: This checks start result, not completion of a particular frame.

zh.plain: begin_replay_motion 将准备好的 replay 目标交给 backend 控制器，并在入口验证通信与 controller readiness。
zh.condition: 源码判断：`not self.is_comm_connected()`；`not self.is_started()`。表达式逐项决定此节点是否继续。
zh.effect: 已连接且已启动后才继续发送 replay 帧；后端记录 active scope 和取消状态。
zh.failure: 先完成连接和 ENABLE，再按返回的状态原因开始 Replay。
zh.recovery: 这是后端入口，UI 按钮在前一节点做 start/stop 调度。
zh.unknown: Only after connection and controller startup does it send Replay frames; the backend tracks active scope and cancellation.
zh.difference: Connect and ENABLE first, then start Replay using the returned status reason.
zh.change: This is the backend entry; the UI button handles start/stop dispatch in the prior node.

en.plain: begin_replay_motion passes prepared Replay targets to the backend controller after checking communication and controller readiness.
en.condition: Source predicates: `not self.is_comm_connected()`; `not self.is_started()`. Each expression determines whether this node continues.
en.effect: 串口离线或 controller 未启动时拒绝开始；后续 P4 状态也可能拒绝目标。
en.failure: 该入口不证明 P4 已执行第一帧或机械动作正确。
en.recovery: 基线未标记该后端入口为变更。
en.unknown: It rejects when serial is offline or the controller is not started; P4 state can still reject later targets.
en.difference: This entry point does not prove P4 executed the first frame or that motion was correct.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this backend entry as changed.

zh.plain: Replay 入口首先要求主机与 P4 通信连接。
zh.condition: 源码判断：`not self.is_comm_connected()`。表达式逐项决定此节点是否继续。
zh.effect: is_comm_connected 为真才继续检查 controller 是否启动。
zh.failure: 条件为真时串口离线，拒绝并不发送回放帧；为假时继续检查 controller。
zh.recovery: 这是通信准入门，不是轨迹文件校验。
zh.unknown: Only a connected link proceeds to the controller-start check.
zh.difference: Connect the serial port and wait for feedback to refresh.
zh.change: This is a communications gate, not trajectory-file validation.

en.plain: The Replay entry first requires host-to-P4 communication.
en.condition: Source predicates: `not self.is_comm_connected()`. Each expression determines whether this node continues.
en.effect: Only a connected link proceeds to the controller-start check.
en.failure: When true, serial is offline and frames are not sent; when false, check controller readiness.
en.recovery: 基线未标记该守卫为变更。
en.unknown: Offline means trajectory frames are not sent.
en.difference: A connection does not prove CAN, servos, or encoders are all healthy.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this guard as changed.

zh.plain: Replay 还要求 controller 已启动；仅打开串口不足以授权运动目标。
zh.condition: 源码判断：`not self.is_started()`。表达式逐项决定此节点是否继续。
zh.effect: is_started 为真后才交给后续 scope 和 state 检查。
zh.failure: 条件为真时 controller 未启动，拒绝回放；为假时继续后续 scope/state 检查。
zh.recovery: 这是控制器生命周期门禁，与连接门禁独立。
zh.unknown: Only after is_started is true does Replay proceed to scope/state checks.
zh.difference: Use ENABLE and confirm READY in the status before retrying.
zh.change: This lifecycle gate is separate from the connection gate.

en.plain: Replay also requires the controller to be started; opening serial alone does not authorize motion targets.
en.condition: Source predicates: `not self.is_started()`. Each expression determines whether this node continues.
en.effect: 未启动时提前拒绝，不发送回放帧。
en.failure: When true, the controller is not started and Replay is rejected; when false, continue scope/state checks.
en.recovery: 基线未标记该守卫为变更。
en.unknown: If not started, it rejects early and sends no playback frame.
en.difference: See the P4 state graph for exact firmware READY/started semantics.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this guard as changed.

zh.plain: 该条件边将当前操作交给对应守卫；真假结果及执行后果见条件详情。
zh.condition: 源码判断：`self.service.is_running()`。表达式逐项决定此节点是否继续。
zh.effect: _send_or_stop 按 is_running 分支调用 service stop/cancel。
zh.failure: 条件为真时已有回放在运行，改走 stop/cancel；为假时准备启动新回放。
zh.recovery: 这是按钮的运行态切换条件。
zh.unknown: _send_or_stop branches to service stop/cancel when is_running is true.
zh.difference: 边解释控制流方向；对应节点说明具体 UI/后端结果和恢复步骤。
zh.change: This is the button’s running-state toggle.

en.difference: The edge explains control-flow direction; the node describes concrete UI/backend results and recovery.
